checks: Stable question key suppresses repeated wording/jobs
Answer stored as new Evidence without changing original/reason
Retry preserves question, response and Evidence IDs
Re-entry and extraction cannot force answered question open
Re-extraction resolves the saved answer text
New operation cannot overwrite an answered question
Skip persisted without fake answer or repeated question
Deferred question can be explicitly answered later
Changed Experience invalidates a pending question without deleting draft/previous answers
scope: Local SQLite reference only, no HTTP server or live AI
